tenderSchedule.title: Providing Consultancy Services as (Third) party Inspection & Monitoring for all developmental & maintenance works, procurement of goods & Services under Kolar urban development authority
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Consultancy Services as (Third) party Inspection & Monitoring for all developmental & maintenance works, procurement of goods & Services under Kolar urban development authority

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The number of points to be given under each of the evaluation criteria are as below & minimum qualification marks is 80. The agency with marks less than 80 shall be rejected technically
The bidder should quote in percentage

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have successfully completed at least 3 Consultancy of value not less than Rs.15 Cr in Supervision and Quality assurance for Construction of Roads, Drains, U.G.D, Buildings & Electrical installations, Mechanical Equipments like pumps, motors, etc., in last 5 years in Govt/Semi Govt. organizations.

Consultant should submit proof of payment consultant fee of minimum Rs. 10.00 lakhs received from State/Central Government and their undertaking agencies in the financial year (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency shall be an Indian company/ firm (It must be registered under particular act (GOI/GOK). Also agency should have valid ISO 9001 : 2015 certificate
The Agency shall have 05-10 years experience in quality monitoring/ supervision of works in Govt/Semi Govt. organizations.
The Key professional staff shall be as detailed below

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Key professional staff shall be as detailed below

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Agency should have Own or leased fully equipped National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratory (NABL) for Quality assurance of Civil, Electrical & Mechanical application usage materials, in Karnataka State also Own or leased fully equipped Quality Analysis Mobile Laboratory for Quality assurance of Civil, Electrical & Mechanical application usage materials / tied-up with NABL Laboratory and mobile Laboratory document for the same should be submitted

The Agency should have achieved Rs.20.00 Lakhs annual turnover in any two years of the last Five Financial Years. Copies of Income Tax Returns for the last Five Financial Years (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).
